summary: Iter 216h228 Wave 1 mobile audit testing. Verified cross-cutting fixes for popover/dropdown overflow, FAB stacking rails, and trial banner clipping. QuickCreate dropdown and form render correctly within viewport on mobile. Notifications panel has a positioning issue on mobile (clips off-screen). No horizontal overflow detected on any tested page. Desktop regression passes - dropdowns still anchor to RIGHT.

ui_bugs.issue: Notifications panel clips off-screen on mobile (390px viewport). Panel is 320px wide and anchored to right-0 relative to button wrapper, but button is positioned far right in toolbar, causing panel to extend off left edge of viewport.
ui_bugs.repro_steps: 1. Open /crm on 390x844 viewport, 2. Click notifications bell, 3. Panel renders with left edge at -67px to -241px (off-screen)
ui_bugs.suggested_fix: Use a React portal to render the panel at document root level, or use fixed positioning with viewport-relative coordinates on mobile. The current approach of centering relative to the button wrapper doesn't work because the button is near the right edge of the viewport.

action_items: Fix NotificationsBell panel positioning on mobile - use portal or fixed positioning to ensure panel stays within viewport
Consider applying same fix pattern to any other toolbar dropdowns that may have similar issues
critical_code_review_comments: The Wave 1 fixes for QuickCreate dropdown work correctly - menu and form both render within viewport on mobile
Global CSS rails in index.css (lines 1596-1642) are working - no horizontal overflow detected on any page
Trial banner spacer (62px) is correctly added in App.js for trial users
The NotificationsBell centering approach (max-sm:left-1/2 max-sm:-translate-x-1/2) doesn't work because it centers relative to the button wrapper, not the viewport
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wave 1 mobile audit focused on CRM page. QuickCreate dropdown/form positioning is fixed and working. NotificationsBell panel still clips on mobile - needs portal-based or fixed-position solution. Other pages (dashboard, memberships, marketing, pulse) show no horizontal overflow. Desktop regression passes - all dropdowns still anchor to RIGHT correctly.
